title: Key stakeholders have limited time during discovery
description: Discovery sessions may slip if the customer's process owners are unavailable.
mitigation: Book discovery sessions two weeks ahead and share agendas early.

title: Integration access may be delayed
description: Customer credentials for the integration may not arrive before build starts.
mitigation: Request access early and escalate through the blocked-request rule.

title: Reference data quality is unknown
description: The reference data file has not been checked and may need cleanup before loading.
mitigation: Run a sample load and review errors with the customer contact.

title: Sponsor may change during discovery
description: A change of customer sponsor could reopen agreed requirements.
mitigation: Confirmed the sponsor for the full project with the customer.

title: End-user training may be incomplete before launch
description: Some user groups may not finish training before the launch date.
mitigation: Add a make-up session and track sign-offs daily.

title: Final data load could overlap launch week
description: The final data load window is close to the launch date.
mitigation: The sponsor accepted the timing; the load plan includes a fallback step.
